title_en: Funny Stories from Life (5/20): Grandma Scares Off a Scammer with a Wok Spatula
note_en: The pattern 又……又…… joins two qualities or feelings at once: 儿子又好气又好笑 "her son didn't know whether to be angry or amused" (literally "both angry-making and laugh-making"). English needs "both... and..." or a whole idiom, but Chinese just puts 又 before each adjective; 好气 and 好笑 here use 好 to mean "easy to / makes you."
